events.title: Guardians of Arcadia® first trailer is out!
events.summary: Guardians of Arcadia® is a indie JRPG made from fans to fans. Our goal is to provide a nostalgic feel on a genre that gently but slowly is getting more attention, mainly due to indie game developers like ourselves. So let's begin 2017 on the right foot by releasing the First Official Trailer of GUARDIANS OF ARCADIA. You can see it now on our store page!
